requirements.requirement: It needs to feel responsive. I think, well, reps get frustrated if screens hang; small navigations should be nearly instantaneous.

requirements.requirement: Peak concurrency is important because the operations floor can be busy. We should size for a few hundred simultaneous active users so that the system doesn't slow when everyone is working.

requirements.requirement: Design and load tests should target support for 350 concurrent users without application-level performance degradation.

requirements.requirement: It needs to be essentially always available because cardmembers and merchants can open or escalate matters at any time, and there are external systems that expect availability.

requirements.requirement: The windows we've coordinated with operations are early morning slots, Monday through Saturday, a one-hour window overnight, and a longer window on Sunday mornings.
